senses.gloss: f. (preced.) rulership, office. Y. Ab. Zar. III, beg. 42ᵇ אם … שהן של ש׳ if it is sure that they (the images) represent officers, opp. של מלכים royal images (which are worshipped).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68">Gen. R. s. 68</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 28:12">Gen. XXVIII, 12</cite>) <he>אלו שרי … ששָׁלְטְנוּתָן גומרת בהן</he> that means the genii of the four empires whose power is complete through them (?).—Pl. <he>שׁוּלְטָנִיּוֹת</he>, <cite ref="U00425"><he>שָׁלְ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82">Gen. R. s. 82</cite> <he>היו מלכיות וש׳ רוצות וכ׳</he> (not <he>ושלטנות</he>; ed. Wil. <he>ושלטוניות</he>, corr. acc.) royalties and governorships were anxious to be connected with them, v. <cite ref="U01285"><he>שִׁלְטוֹן</he></cite>.
